name: Survival
line: Hold one base inside a perimeter while the waves come, then take the enemy base. The enemies are rolled from the run's seed, so no two runs send the same army.
comment: data is the mod's own folder: types.json, scripts/, looks.json and lang/ sit beside mod.json. See API-NEEDS.md, "A mode mod's own folder".

mode.line: Waves until the count runs out, then the push.
mode.about: One home inside a perimeter read from the map. A build-up with no waves, then a wave every gap, cleared or not, out of the enemy base. Every fifth wave is an assault, a quarter again as big, through two gates, led by an elite. Clearing the last wave lifts the perimeter; with the push on, the enemy base is then an ordinary computer player and its last building ends the game.
notes: The waves are the race the enemy base plays, chosen in its slot like any computer. Random is drawn from the run's seed.
Units outside the perimeter lose a share of their own life every second. The four tiles just outside it are a warning only.
The perimeter grows four tiles every fifth wave cleared.

settings.name: Difficulty
settings.gist: How many waves come, how big they are, how far apart, from which wave elites ride, and how the enemy base plays after the lift.

settings.name: Perimeter
settings.gist: How far the edge sits from your base. It is read from the map, not set in tiles, so one choice fits every map.

settings.name: Allies' perimeter
settings.gist: With two to four players, one perimeter round every home or one round each.

settings.name: Push the enemy base
settings.gist: On, clearing the last wave lifts the perimeter and the enemy base is yours to take. Off, clearing the last wave is the win.

settings.name: Unique groups
settings.gist: How often a group that walks in is a unique group: every unit in it sharing one rolled set of effects, with a name and a look of its own. Stronger than the line it comes with, weaker than an elite.

settings.name: Show next wave
settings.gist: The counter names what the next wave carries, its elites and the rolled mid-bosses among them.

settings.name: Elites
settings.gist: How strong the elites are and how often they ride, against the run's own schedule. Every elite is rolled, whatever body it wears: its stats, its affixes, its spell and its name are new each run.

settings.name: Start at wave
settings.gist: The wave the run begins at, for trying a wave without playing up to it. 1 plays the whole run.

settings.name: Run
settings.gist: The number the whole run is rolled from: its waves, its elites, the mid-bosses and their spells. Type one in to play the same run again.

presets.name: Holdout
presets.line: A perimeter each and no base to take: hold your own start until the waves run out.

presets.name: The gauntlet
presets.line: Insane, tight, no preview: forty waves on one base, and nothing named before it arrives.
